# Mozilla PDF.js

Vendored from `pdfjs-dist@6.5.438` on npm, with scripts disabled. Legacy browser API and worker are kept at the same pinned version. Upstream: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js

Apache-2.0 license and all bundled font/codec licenses are retained. No document scripting or viewer is bundled. Runtime assets are served locally for offline import.
